# Setup

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(testflow)
library(rstatix)
library(here)

# Load agricultural biomass dataset
forest_soc <- read_csv(here("data", "theme5_ghg_afolu.csv"))
head(forest_soc)
```

# Tasks

1. Conduct a two-sample t-test comparing soil organic carbon levels across crop types using `testflow::test_t_two_sample()`. Print the diagnostic plots.
2. Conduct the same independent t-test using `rstatix::t_test()`.
3. Assess normality using `rstatix::shapiro_test()` by group.
4. Calculate Cohen's d effect size.

Write your parametric testing code below:

```{r}
# --- testflow Pipeline ---
soc_comparison <- test_t_two_sample(
  data = forest_soc,
  response = "soil_organic_carbon_pct",
  group = "crop_type"
)
report(soc_comparison)

# Plot residuals diagnostics
plot(soc_comparison)

# --- rstatix Alternative ---
# 1. Shapiro-Wilk test for normality
forest_soc %>% 
  group_by(crop_type) %>% 
  shapiro_test(soil_organic_carbon_pct)

# 2. Independent t-test
stat_test <- forest_soc %>% 
  t_test(soil_organic_carbon_pct ~ crop_type, detailed = TRUE)
print(stat_test)

# 3. Cohen's d Effect Size
effect_sz <- forest_soc %>% 
  cohens_d(soil_organic_carbon_pct ~ crop_type)
print(effect_sz)
```
